04 Behind the crawl

Every observation has a source.
[01]

Find the project

Claus reads the public registry and follows its recorded connections. Only Claus Network projects get a visit.

[02]

Follow the evidence

Every trip across the map is a logged step: read a profile, match published activity, then inspect the record.

[03]

Keep the context

“Recent” means an update or event within seven days of its source observation. Activity is a signal, not a security audit.

Data sources, coverage & limitations +

The registry includes technical references. Featured projects come from the narrower public Home feed. Counts describe returned public records, not users, active agents, or independent teams. An absent event does not prove inactivity.

Live reads can fail or be blocked by a provider. Each source then falls back independently to the dated cache. Reports keep these sources separate. Pagination is followed for up to 20 pages per source; any remaining cursor is disclosed as partial coverage.
